notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Comet Strike has been out for nearly two months and we are very grateful for your support. We have been keeping a close eye on feedback, and have made some changes just in time for the summer! Let’s talk about what is new in this free update patch.

Update Highlights

Summer Sale Discount 30% (During Sale Times)
Global Leaderboards
Endless Mode Difficulties: Beginner, Normal, and Expert
Endless Mode Accessibility: Unlocked much sooner
Steam Achievement Support
Cloud Save Support
General Bug Fixes


Summer Sale Participation
Enjoy 30% off when the summer sale starts for a limited time as our thanks to you! Happy Summer!

Leaderboards Now Online
Every level, including endless mode, will have a unique top 10 global leaderboard! Keep track of your own ranking and shoot for the top!

New Endless Difficulties: Beginner, Normal, and Expert
Endless mode is the end-game arcade experience we wanted veteran players to grind out once they have finished the main quest series. While we want this mode to be challenging, but we realize that many skill levels exist. One difficulty means having a mode that is too difficult for newer players and too easy for skilled veterans. The difficulty split will provide an enjoyable experience for first-time friends, while also catering to our expert players.

Endless Mode Accessibility
Endless mode will now be unlocked after completing the tutorial planet (Kepler 1-5). We want to deliver the full arcade experience to players as soon as possible. Skills must still be unlocked through completing their respective levels.

Steam Achievement Support
Steam API integration is now complete. Several achievements have been added for you to unlock! Because this is a new feature, some progress towards achievements will start after the update.

Cloud Saving Support
We realize how important mobility between computers is to our users. Steam Cloud is now available, and will upload your current save data to the cloud the next time you play the game.

General Bug Fixes
Thank you for your help in finding bugs. These are the highlights of bug fixes this patch:

Touch UI Responsiveness Fixed
 Visual Bugs Removed
General Quality of Life Improvements


That is all for today! For any questions, feedback, or anything else, please feel free to comment to this post, or write a new thread in the forums. Once again, thank you for all the support, and we hope you will enjoy the update!
